title.narrative: UKFCDO: SGCIF-Bridging the Gaps of Climate Finance in Central Asia

description.narrative: The overall project objective is to bridge the climate finance gaps and enhance green investment opportunities in the Republic of Uzbekistan and the Kyrgyz Republic by accelerating green transition of the financial sector. For this purpose, the project will analyze existing climate finance ecosystems and gaps, build the capacity of public and private entities to access green finance and develop two Sustainable/Green financing frameworks or dedicated green/climate financing facility that align with the highest international standards to foster robust green finance landscape across the region (one financial institution per each region Republic of Uzbekistan and the Kyrgyz Republic).

This project aims to strengthend climate finance readiness and ecosystem building in Central Asia by identifying instituitonal gaps and practical entry points for scaling up investments in climate mitigation and adaptation. Focusing on Uzbekistan and Kyrgyzstan, the project will engage key public and private actors through assessments, dialogues, and targeted capacity building.GGGI will lead proejct implementation, including institutional gap assessments, engagement of private sector stakeholders (e.g. banks, asset managers), and development of a prioritized action plan and investment entry points. The project will contribute to increasing the region's access to international climate financing, aligning with the goals of the Paris Agreement and national NDCs.The total project budget is EUR 400,000 (approx. USD 459,016), with activities scheduled from September 2025 to March 2026. The project directly engages over 100 stakeholders, including at least 30% women and promotes climate finance awareness through workshops, communication materials, and a final regional policy forum.
